q: Menurut Work at Height Regulations 2005 (UK), 'kerja' di tempat tinggi TIDAK termasuk:
c: Perjalanan ke atau dari tempat kerja
w: Kerja di bawah paras tanah yang boleh menyebabkan jatuh
e: UK 2005: 'work' includes moving around at a place of work (except by a staircase in a permanent workplace) but not travel to or from a place of work.

q: Menurut UK 2005, bergerak menggunakan tangga (staircase) di tempat kerja kekal:
c: Dikecualikan daripada takrif kerja di tempat tinggi
w: Sentiasa dianggap kerja di tempat tinggi
e: 'Work' includes moving around at a place of work (except by a staircase in a permanent workplace).

q: Garis panduan Kiwi (New Zealand) dan UK mentakrifkan kerja di tempat tinggi sebagai bekerja di tempat di mana seseorang boleh cedera jika:
c: Jatuh dari satu aras ke aras lain
e: Work at height means working in a place where a person could be injured if they fell from one level to another.

q: Kawasan contoh kerja di tempat tinggi yang ditunjukkan termasuk:
c: Menara, tepi bumbung, perancah dan skylift
w: Tempat letak kereta bawah tanah sahaja
e: Examples area of heights: rope access & gondola, tower & confined space, roof and building edge, scaffold and skylifts.

q: Dalam Garis Panduan Pencegahan Jatuh 2007, bahagian 7 berkaitan dengan:
e: Topics: 1 design & organisational; 2 general safety; 3 permanent fixed access; 4 temporary access; 5 scaffolding; 6 mechanical plant; 7 safety nets; 8 safety lines, belts, harnesses; 9 roped-access; 10 construction & maintenance; 11 steel erection; 12 roof; 13 broadcast & telecommunication structures.

q: Bahagian dalam Garis Panduan 2007 yang berkaitan menara penyiaran dan telekomunikasi ialah bahagian:
e: Section 13: Broadcast and Telecommunication Structures.

q: 'Mechanical plant for the support of personnel' dalam Garis Panduan 2007 merujuk kepada peralatan seperti:
e: Section 6: Mechanical Plant for the Support of Personnel (contoh skylift, platform kerja bergerak).

q: Dalam sistem fall arrest, tenaga jatuh perlu:
e: Fall arrest prevents risk by: reducing distance of fall, absorbing the energy of fall, maintaining worker's position.

q: Sistem work restraint biasanya terdiri daripada:
c: Tali pinggang keselamatan dan talian penambat (anchorage line)
e: Work restraint: prevents reaching a place where a fall is possible; can consist of a safety belt and anchorage line.

q: Work positioning menyediakan sokongan utama supaya kerja boleh dijalankan dengan:
e: Work positioning: primary means of support and restraint to allow work in reasonable comfort; hands free.

q: Peralatan yang membantu prinsip memanjat termasuk:
c: Lanyard tunggal/berkembar dan lanyard work positioning
e: Climbing principle: 3 points contact; with the help of lanyard (single/double) and work positioning lanyard.

q: Memasang piring satelit dan menukar mentol lampu di tempat tinggi ialah contoh:
e: Activities at heights: window cleaning, painting tower, changing light bulb, welding at silo, installation of satellite dish.

q: Pemasangan kren menara (tower crane erection) dan pemeriksaan bumbung ialah contoh:
e: Activities shown: lifting, tower crane erection, window cleaning, glass window installation, roof inspection, change tower bulb, rescue.

q: Kebocoran kabel elektrik hidup pada menara ialah bahaya di tempat tinggi jenis:
e: Hazards at heights: unsecured workers/tools, faulty equipment, leakage of live electric cable on tower, oily rungs, weather, psychosocial, heat stress, ergonomic.

q: Pekerja, peralatan atau alatan yang tidak diikat semasa memanjat atau bekerja di tempat tinggi ialah:
e: Hazard 1: workers, equipment or tools not secured/attached during climbing/working.

q: Langkah kawalan untuk PEKERJA (bukan loji) di tempat tinggi termasuk:
c: Work restraint, work positioning, fall arrest dan 3 titik sentuhan
e: Control measures – Workers: work restraint, work positioning, fall arrest, 3 points contact; Plant: edge protection, catch platform, safety nets, barricade.

q: Platform penangkap (catch platform) berfungsi untuk:
c: Menangkap pekerja atau bahan yang jatuh dari aras atas
e: Plant controls: edge protection, catch platform, safety nets, barricade of work area.

q: Selepas memilih peralatan kerja, kecemasan dan menyelamat, langkah kawalan seterusnya ialah:
e: Control steps: 1 HIRARC/JSA; 2 work procedure; 3 permit approved; 4 select trained team; 5 select equipment; 6 prepare rescue and emergency procedure.

q: Dalam kajian kes Lebuhraya Cheras-Seremban, pekerja jatuh kerana:
c: Sebuah kenderaan melanggar kren yang mengangkatnya
e: Case study 2: worker elevated by crane 70 ft to chop dead branches when a Mitsubishi Pajero rammed into the crane; he lost balance and fell.

q: Dalam kes Perai (Mac 2025), mangsa ialah pekerja yang sedang:
e: Case study 3: construction worker died after falling 12 m while repairing the roof of a manufacturing factory in Perai; employer directed to conduct internal investigation.
